title: Three Days on the Oregon Coast Trail
excerpt: Notes, gear, and one very close call with the tide.
content:
I planned this as an easy three-day stretch and nearly got caught by an incoming tide on day two — a good reminder to actually check tide tables instead of eyeballing it.

Full gear list and route notes below.

title: The One Lens I'd Keep If I Lost Everything Else
excerpt: Not the widest, not the sharpest — just the one I actually reach for.
content: I own three lenses and travel with all of them, but if I could only keep one, it wouldn't be the widest or technically sharpest — it'd be the 35mm, because it's the one I actually reach for without thinking.
